eas_text: A civil authority has issued A REQUIRED WEEKLY TEST for the following counties or areas: Indiana; at 11:30 AM on AUG 12, 2013 Effective until 1:30 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is a test.  This is ONLY a test.  The Indiana Department of Homeland Security, Response Division, is conducting the required weekly test of the Emergency Alert System for all Indiana locations as required by the Indiana State EAS Plan. Further information may be found at the getprepared.in.gov website.  This concludes this test of the Emergency Alert System.
